data.name: CSM_001
data.value: The crystals are humming...[pause=15] As if they were singing for someone.

data.name: CSM_002
data.value: (The light is freezing over the walls.[pause=15] Something is waiting to be seen.)

data.name: CSM_003
data.value: The threshold welcomes only limpid souls.[pause=20] Doubt shatters against the crystal.

data.name: CSM_004
data.value: A Carbink![pause=15] It's glittering among the gems!

data.name: CSM_005
data.value: A Froslass![pause=15] The air is freezing around her!

data.name: CSM_006
data.value: Visitors of the threshold.[pause=15] Measure your light against ours.

data.name: CSM_007
data.value: The cold keeps the sanctuary from lukewarm hearts.

data.name: CSM_008
data.value: We came to save,[pause=10] not to plunder![pause=15] [hero],[pause=10] show them!

data.name: CSM_009
data.value: The herald and the spectre are still on watch.[pause=15] This time we pass!

data.name: CSM_010
data.value: Your light stands tall.[pause=20] The threshold acknowledges you.

data.name: CSM_011
data.value: The cold withdraws.[pause=15] Pass,[pause=10] limpid hearts.

data.name: CSM_012
data.value: The way to the chamber is open...[pause=15] Diancie is close now!

data.name: CSM_013
data.value: (They weren't hostile.[pause=15] They were making sure we were worthy.)

data.name: CSM_014
data.value: Too lukewarm.[pause=20] The threshold has refused you.

data.name: CSM_015
data.value: The crystal judges, it does not hate.[pause=20] Warm your heart,[pause=10] then return.
